title: Omarchy RDP
intro: A second desktop on this machine that you reach over RDP, separate from this one: same apps and settings, its own windows. Logging in remotely locks this desk; unlocking the desk ends the RDP connection.
setUp.caption: Installs hypr-rdp and opens port 3389 to your network · asks for your password
remote.restartPending: Updated: restart it to use the rebuilt libaquamarine
disconnect.caption: Cut the connection from %1; the session keeps running
restart.caption: Closes its windows and starts it fresh
notify.rebuilt.title: Remote session updated
notify.rebuilt.body: The patched libaquamarine was rebuilt for the aquamarine update. Restart the remote session from the bar to use it.
notify.rebuildFailed.title: Remote session needs attention
notify.rebuildFailed.body: The patched libaquamarine didn't build after the aquamarine update. Open the Omarchy RDP panel for details.
desk.title: Desk
mode.title: Share the desk session over RDP
mode.shared: On: RDP shows this session, the same windows as the console. It locks when RDP disconnects.
mode.headless: Off: RDP gets its own separate session, so the desk and RDP can each be in use.
mode.confirm: Click again: this closes the remote session
desk.none: Not logged in · the console shows the login screen
remote.title: Remote session
note.title: Why log out the other session?
note.body: Both sessions are you, the same user. Some apps only allow one copy per user (browsers on the same profile, chat and music apps, password managers), so they can only run in one of them. Any still open in the other session would bring their windows up there instead of here, or say they're already running. Logging it out closes its apps, so they open where you are.
